source_snapshot.procedure: Run local raw 0x2c 0x07 0xdc 0x01 <Entity ID> 0x01 0 for 0x40 inlet, 0x41 CPU and 0x42 baseboard, then inspect response data.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command should be sent without error.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES with ipmitool, but substitutes an SSH-wrapped aggregate `dcmi sensors` command and leaves semantic judgment to the user.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE with per-entity raw requests, decoder validation, inventory comparison, bounded reads and preserved logs.

historical_reviews.deepseek: The aggregate command can provide supplemental inventory but does not demonstrate each source-listed raw entity request or its response framing.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly preserves read-only automation while adding entity, instance, units, scaling and status checks.
historical_reviews.history: The invalidated prior-run location was found but excluded as authority; the preceding asset-tag setter and adjacent OOB variant were compared only for boundary and transport identity.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A zero completion code proves transport acceptance, not that every requested entity and instance decoded to the intended sensor population.

original_test_intent: Read DCMI sensor information for the inlet, CPU and baseboard entity groups through the local in-band interface and verify that each returned record belongs to the requested entity with valid status and value semantics.
original_method: Retain the exact local raw 0x2c/0x07 request and the three source entity IDs, executing bounded read-only queries with schema-aware decoding and inventory comparison.
manual_activity: The project supplies the target DCMI response schema, fitted entity/instance inventory and acceptable sensor status/range context; the end user owns PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED.
safety_requirements: Bound each query and retry count
Do not set thresholds or thermal policy
Preserve malformed and unsupported raw responses
agent_execution_scope: Bind the local interface to the intended SUT
Issue each exact bounded raw entity request
Decode entity, instance, units, scaling, status and reading
engineer_actions: Provide schema, inventory and range inputs

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `ipmitool dcmi sensors` is a useful supplemental view, but it neither proves that the exact raw request was issued for each listed entity nor exposes all response-frame validation; SSH is also unnecessary for the named local route unless the execution topology is separately approved.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: On the verified local BMC interface, issue `ipmitool raw 0x2c 0x07 0xdc 0x01 <entity> 0x01 0` once for each of 0x40, 0x41 and 0x42, decode every bounded response and compare it with the approved inventory.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source netfn, command, group extension, operation bytes, entity map and 10/5 timing remain; no instance, range or retry value is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform three explicitly attributed DCMI entity reads under a common time/load context, validate framing and semantic fields, and report missing, unsupported or malformed entities without substituting a different sensor command.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a semantic oracle, per-entity evidence and no-mutation controls beyond command-success acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An aggregate high-level listing is supplemental and cannot replace proof of the exact source-listed raw request for each entity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: CPU entity 0x41 may contain multiple instances, and stale, transient or mis-scaled readings can appear plausible unless instance, status, units and timestamp are retained.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API or high-level DCMI listing is equivalent only if it proves the same three entity groups, preserves per-instance raw/decoded semantics and discloses omitted raw-protocol coverage.
expected_evidence: Schema, decoder version and expected entity/instance inventory
Per-entity exact request and complete raw response
Completion, length, entity/instance, units, scaling, status and reading
No thermal, power, reset, configuration or log mutation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, procedure, entity map and raw request consistently describe an in-band DCMI sensor-information read. The success-only criterion is incomplete rather than contradictory, and the DeepSeek aggregate command is an overlay coverage defect.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation, transport and entities are explicit. Schema, inventory and project ranges are ordinary execution inputs and do not prevent completion of the engineering review.

review_improvement: Turns a transport-success check into a per-entity, per-instance DCMI sensor validation with preserved raw evidence and explicit read-only boundaries.
independent_technical_reasoning: The DCMI response must be tied to the requested entity and instance before a numeric byte sequence can be called an inlet, CPU or baseboard temperature. Completion, response length, units/scaling and reading status are independent gates; a high-level label or successful command alone can conceal missing CPU instances, unsupported entities or malformed data.
